{"edits": [{"finding_ids": ["pydantic_cli/__init__.py:227"], "search": "    field: pydantic.fields.ModelField,", "replace": "    field: pydantic.fields.FieldInfo,", "explanation": "Pydantic v2 removed `ModelField`; the annotation is evaluated at import time, which is the cause of the collection failure. In v2, `cls.model_fields` values are `FieldInfo` objects, so `pydantic.fields.FieldInfo` is the correct annotation (see migration.md, `__fields__` -> `model_fields`)."}], "notes": "Only the annotation fix is proposed, because it is what causes the collection-time AttributeError. The `__fields__` -> `model_fields` finding (line 348) is already applied in the current content. The receivers `cls` are Pydantic models, so the finding is valid and needs no further change.

Not addressed, and worth a follow-up because they are runtime failures in v2 rather than import failures. I left them alone because fixing them changes behavior and goes beyond the listed findings:
- In `_add_pydantic_field_to_parser`, the body still uses ModelField-only attributes on a FieldInfo: `field.required`, `field.default`, `field.type_`, `field.allow_none`, `field.shape`, and `field.field_info.extra` (v2 renamed this to `json_schema_extra`). Equivalents are `field.is_required()`, `field.default`, `field.annotation`, and so on, but the bool/Optional/list handling needs a careful rewrite.
- `pydantic.fields.SHAPE_LIST` and `SHAPE_SET` no longer exist in v2.
- `cls.schema()` (in `_runner`) and `cls.validate(opts)` are v1 APIs; the v2 equivalents are `model_json_schema()` and `model_validate()`.

These are not part of the collection failure, so they need a separate, behavior-checked edit."}]"}
